caption:
A genuine bulk discount is worth taking seriously, but only if it doesn't come at the cost of cash you need elsewhere, which is exactly the kind of trade-off short-term finance is built to solve.

The maths only works if the saving outweighs the cost of finance, so it's worth running the numbers even when the clock is ticking on the offer.
